dct_title_s: Mariupol Rapid Damage Assessment Overview Map
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: CE20220223UKR** This map illustrates a satellite imagery-based Rapid Damage Building Assessment (RDBA) of the Mariupolska Hromada, Ukraine. The RDBA divides the city into 500m x 500m cells, each of which is analyzed to determine whether or not there are damaged buildings inside the cell. Based on imagery collected on 26 March 2022, analysts found that 556 cells out of 3,456 sustained visible damage. This represents approximately 16% of the cells over the Hromada. Note that not all 6,456 cells include buildings. Numerous craters are also visible in the fields but were not taken into account for this analysis. This analysis is based on structures visibly damaged as of 26 March 2022 as seen in marginally degraded satellite imagery affected by precipitation, seasonality, and other limiting factors. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
